<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2 and the molecular formula C16H27O3 (C=16, H=27, N=0, X=0), the calculation yields DBE = (2*16 + 2 - 27)/2 = 7/2 = 3.5. Since the required output format is an integer, we round to the nearest whole number, giving 3.</thought>
<final_answer>3</final_answer>
